senses.en: without danger or harm

ex.en: The children crossed the road safely.
ex.zh: 孩子们安全地过了马路。

ex.en: Drive safely in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨天开车注意安全。

tip: safely 是 safe 的副词“安全地”。
scene: Children using a crossing to cross the road safely.

senses.en: a deep pan with a handle for cooking

ex.en: She boiled the soup in a saucepan.
ex.zh: 她用炖锅煮汤。

ex.en: Put the saucepan on the stove, please.
ex.zh: 请把炖锅放到炉子上。

tip: saucepan 是带柄的深锅，用来煮汤/炖菜。
scene: A saucepan with soup boiling on a stove.

senses.en: stories about the future and space

ex.en: She loves reading science fiction novels.
ex.zh: 她喜欢读科幻小说。

ex.en: The film is a science fiction about robots.
ex.zh: 这部电影是关于机器人的科幻片。

tip: science fiction 是科幻文学/电影，口语简称 sci-fi。
scene: A spaceship flying past planets on a book cover.

senses.en: to look for something carefully

ex.en: I searched online for a cheap hotel.
ex.zh: 我在网上搜索便宜的酒店。

ex.en: The search for the missing cat continued all day.
ex.zh: 寻找失踪猫咪的行动持续了一整天。

tip: search for 是“搜索寻找”；search engine 是搜索引擎。
scene: A person typing a search query into a laptop.

senses.en: a strap that keeps you safe in a car

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we drive.
ex.zh: 开车前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt.
ex.zh: 车里每个人都要系安全带。

col: fasten your seat belt｜系安全带
tip: fasten/put on your seat belt 是“系安全带”。
scene: A hand fastening a seat belt in a car.

senses.en: a person who protects a building or people

ex.en: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
ex.zh: 保安在入口检查了我们的包。

ex.en: A security guard watches the building at night.
ex.zh: 保安夜里看守大楼。

tip: security guard 是保安/警卫人员。
scene: A security guard in uniform checking bags at a building entrance.

senses.en: in a serious way; very badly

ex.en: You should take your studies seriously.
ex.zh: 你应该认真对待学业。

ex.en: He was seriously hurt in the accident.
ex.zh: 他在事故中受了重伤。

tip: take sth seriously 是“认真对待某事”。
scene: A student studying seriously with books and notes at a desk.

senses.en: a computer that stores data, or a waiter

ex.en: The website is on a server in another country.
ex.zh: 这个网站在另一个国家的服务器上。

ex.en: The server brought our drinks quickly.
ex.zh: 服务员很快送来了我们的饮料。

tip: server 指电脑“服务器”，美式也指餐厅“服务员”。
scene: A row of server machines with blinking lights in a data room.

senses.en: to start a journey

ex.en: We set off for the beach at eight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我们早上八点出发去海滩。

ex.en: They set off early to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 他们早出发以避开交通拥堵。

tip: set off 表示“出发”；set off for + 目的地。
scene: A family with bags setting off from home early in the morning.

senses.en: to start a journey or task, or to arrange

ex.en: She set out to learn Spanish last year.
ex.zh: 她去年开始学西班牙语。

ex.en: We set out the picnic food on the blanket.
ex.zh: 我们把野餐食物摆到毯子上。

tip: set out 表示“出发/着手”；set out to do 是“开始做”。
scene: A picnic blanket with food laid out on a green lawn.

senses.en: to start a business or arrange equipment

ex.en: They set up a small company last year.
ex.zh: 他们去年创办了一家小公司。

ex.en: Help me set up the tent, please.
ex.zh: 请帮我搭帐篷。

tip: set up 表示“建立、安装、创办”。
scene: Two people setting up a tent in a campsite.

senses.en: very surprising and upsetting

ex.en: The news about the accident was shocking.
ex.zh: 关于事故的消息令人震惊。

ex.en: It is shocking how much plastic is in the sea.
ex.zh: 海里塑料之多令人震惊。

tip: shocking 形容事物；shocked 形容人的感受。
scene: A person reading shocking news on a phone, hand over mouth.

senses.en: to arrive or appear somewhere

ex.en: He didn't show up for the meeting.
ex.zh: 他没有出现在会议上。

ex.en: She showed up ten minutes late.
ex.zh: 她迟到了十分钟才露面。

tip: show up 是口语“出现/露面”，等于 turn up。
scene: An empty chair at a meeting table with people waiting.

senses.en: to join or register for something

ex.en: She signed up for the swimming course.
ex.zh: 她报名参加了游泳课程。

ex.en: You can sign up for the newsletter online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上注册订阅新闻通讯。

tip: sign up for 是“报名参加”。
scene: A person filling in a registration form at a sports centre.

senses.en: without sleeves

ex.en: She wore a sleeveless dress in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天她穿无袖连衣裙。

ex.en: The sleeveless shirt is cool and light.
ex.zh: 这件无袖衬衫凉爽轻便。

tip: sleeveless 是“无袖的”；-less 表示“没有”。
scene: A sleeveless summer dress hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: the amount of snow that falls

ex.en: The city had heavy snowfall last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚这座城市下了大雪。

ex.en: Snowfall in the mountains makes skiing possible.
ex.zh: 山里的降雪使滑雪成为可能。

tip: snowfall 是“降雪/降雪量”。
scene: Snow falling heavily over a small town at night.

senses.en: not very good but not bad either

ex.en: 'How was the film?' 'So-so, not great.'
ex.zh: “电影怎么样？”“一般般，不算好。”

ex.en: My cooking is only so-so.
ex.zh: 我的厨艺一般般。

tip: so-so 是口语“一般般”，表示中等水平。
scene: A person making a so-so gesture with a flat hand.

senses.en: a TV drama shown regularly about people's lives

ex.en: My grandmother watches a soap opera every evening.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每天晚上看肥皂剧。

ex.en: The soap opera has been on TV for twenty years.
ex.zh: 这部肥皂剧已经播了二十年。

tip: soap opera 是肥皂剧，剧情连续、贴近生活。
scene: A TV showing a drama scene with a family watching on a sofa.

senses.zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地
senses.en: in some way, though you don't know how

ex.en: Somehow, we found the way back home.
ex.zh: 不知怎么地，我们找到了回家的路。

ex.en: She somehow finished the race despite the pain.
ex.zh: 尽管疼痛，她还是设法完成了比赛。

tip: somehow 表示“以某种方式/不知怎么地”。
scene: Two lost hikers finding a path back with a map.

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to divide

ex.en: They split up after five years.
ex.zh: 他们五年后分手了。

ex.en: Let's split up and search the park.
ex.zh: 我们分开搜索公园吧。

tip: split up 表示“分手/分开”。
scene: Two people going different ways at a park path fork.

senses.en: to remain in a place after others leave

ex.en: A few students stayed behind to ask questions.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来问问题。

ex.en: Please stay behind after the meeting for a moment.
ex.zh: 会后请留一下。

tip: stay behind 表示“留在原处（别人走后）”。
scene: A student staying behind to talk to the teacher after class.

senses.en: a long narrow line of colour

ex.en: The T-shirt has blue and white stripes.
ex.zh: 这件T恤有蓝白条纹。

ex.en: A zebra has black and white stripes.
ex.zh: 斑马有黑白条纹。

tip: stripe 是条纹；striped 是“有条纹的”。
scene: A blue and white striped T-shirt on a hanger.

senses.en: to sit or lie in the sun to get a tan

ex.en: They sunbathe on the beach every afternoon.
ex.zh: 他们每天下午在海滩上晒太阳。

ex.en: Remember to use sun cream when you sunbathe.
ex.zh: 晒太阳时要涂防晒霜。

tip: sunbathe 是动词“做日光浴”；sunbathing 是名词。
scene: People lying on beach chairs sunbathing with sunglasses.

senses.en: a hero in stories with special powers

ex.en: The superhero saved the city from danger.
ex.zh: 超级英雄拯救了城市。

ex.en: Children love dressing up as superheroes.
ex.zh: 孩子们喜欢打扮成超级英雄。

tip: superhero 是超级英雄；复数 superheroes。
scene: A superhero in a cape flying above a city skyline.

senses.en: a person who supports a team or an idea

ex.en: The football supporters cheered loudly.
ex.zh: 足球迷们大声欢呼。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the environment.
ex.zh: 她是环保的坚定支持者。

tip: supporter 是“支持者”；体育场景中指球迷。
scene: Football supporters cheering with scarves in a stadium.

senses.en: making you feel surprise

ex.en: It is surprising how fast the puppy grew.
ex.zh: 小狗长得这么快真令人惊讶。

ex.en: The surprising result shocked everyone.
ex.zh: 出人意料的结果震惊了所有人。

tip: surprising 形容事物；surprised 形容人的感受。
scene: A person with a surprised face seeing a birthday surprise party.

senses.en: a warm soft shirt with long sleeves

ex.en: He wears a blue sweatshirt to school.
ex.zh: 他穿蓝色卫衣上学。

ex.en: This sweatshirt is warm and comfortable.
ex.zh: 这件卫衣又暖和又舒服。

tip: sweatshirt 是运动卫衣；hoodie 是连帽卫衣。
scene: A blue sweatshirt folded on a bed.

senses.en: a person who swims

ex.en: The swimmer won a gold medal at the games.
ex.zh: 这名游泳运动员在运动会上赢得金牌。

ex.en: She is a strong swimmer.
ex.zh: 她是一个游泳好手。

tip: swimmer 是游泳者/游泳运动员。
scene: A swimmer racing in a pool lane with water splashing.

senses.en: a cloth used to cover a table

ex.en: She spread a white table-cloth for dinner.
ex.zh: 她铺了一块白桌布准备吃晚饭。

ex.en: The table-cloth has a red pattern.
ex.zh: 这块桌布有红色图案。

tip: table-cloth 是桌布；也拼作 tablecloth。
scene: A dining table covered with a white table-cloth and plates.

senses.en: to look after someone or something

ex.en: She takes care of her younger brother.
ex.zh: 她照顾弟弟。

ex.en: Please take care of the problem before Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前处理这个问题。

tip: take care of 是“照顾/处理”，等于 look after。
scene: A girl giving water to a plant she takes care of.

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The concert will take place in the town hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会将市政厅举行。

ex.en: The meeting took place last Friday.
ex.zh: 会议上周五举行。

tip: take place 表示“发生/举行”，比 happen 更正式。
scene: A concert taking place in a town hall with an audience.

senses.en: to start a hobby, or to use space or time

ex.en: She took up painting last year.
ex.zh: 她去年开始学画画。

ex.en: This desk takes up too much space.
ex.zh: 这张桌子太占地方。

tip: take up 表示“开始（爱好）”或“占用（空间/时间）”。
scene: A girl painting at an easel, having taken up painting.

senses.en: cooked food bought to eat at home

ex.en: We ordered a takeaway for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们点了外卖当晚餐。

ex.en: The takeaway round the corner sells pizza.
ex.zh: 拐角的外卖店卖披萨。

tip: takeaway 是英式“外卖”；美式说 take-out。
scene: A takeaway box with pizza being carried out of a shop.

senses.en: to get rid of something

ex.en: Don't throw away the box; we can reuse it.
ex.zh: 别扔掉盒子，我们可以再利用。

ex.en: She threw away the old newspapers.
ex.zh: 她扔掉了旧报纸。

tip: throw away 是“扔掉”；注意环保，减少乱扔。
scene: A hand throwing a paper box into a recycling bin.

senses.en: a jacket and trousers worn for sport

ex.en: He wears a tracksuit for morning running.
ex.zh: 他穿运动套装晨跑。

ex.en: The team trained in matching tracksuits.
ex.zh: 队员们穿着配套的运动套装训练。

tip: tracksuit 是运动服套装（上衣+裤子）。
scene: A grey tracksuit hanging on a hanger in a sports shop.

senses.en: a long line of cars that cannot move

ex.en: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
ex.zh: 我们堵车堵了一个小时。

ex.en: Leave early to avoid the traffic jam.
ex.zh: 早点出发避开堵车。

col: be in a traffic jam｜堵车
tip: be stuck in a traffic jam 是“被困在堵车中”。
scene: A long line of cars stopped on a busy city road.

senses.zh: 旅行社职员；旅行代理人
senses.en: a person who helps you book holidays

ex.en: The travel agent booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社职员帮我们订了机票和酒店。

ex.en: Ask the travel agent about cheap packages.
ex.zh: 问问旅行社职员有哪些便宜套餐。

tip: travel agent 是旅行代理；travel agency 是旅行社。
scene: A travel agent showing holiday brochures to a customer.

senses.en: to reduce sound, or to refuse

ex.en: Please turn down the music; it's too loud.
ex.zh: 请把音乐调小，太吵了。

ex.en: She turned down the job offer.
ex.zh: 她拒绝了这份工作邀请。

tip: turn down 表示“调低”或“拒绝”。
scene: A person turning down the volume on a stereo.

senses.en: to become something different

ex.en: The old factory turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 旧工厂变成了博物馆。

ex.en: Water turns into ice when it freezes.
ex.zh: 水结冰时变成冰。

tip: turn into 表示“变成”；turn A into B 把A变成B。
scene: An old factory building converted into a museum with visitors.

senses.en: to arrive, or to increase sound

ex.en: He turned up at the party with his friends.
ex.zh: 他和朋友们出现在聚会上。

ex.en: Turn up the radio; I can't hear it.
ex.zh: 把收音机调大声，我听不见。

tip: turn up 表示“出现”或“调高”。
scene: A guest arriving at a party door with a gift.

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the match on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: The TV is in the living room.
ex.zh: 电视在客厅里。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写；watch TV 看电视。
scene: A family watching a match on TV in a living room.

senses.en: clothes worn under trousers

ex.en: He bought three pairs of underpants.
ex.zh: 他买了三条内裤。

ex.en: Underpants are usually worn under trousers.
ex.zh: 内裤通常穿在裤子里面。

col: a pair of underpants｜一条内裤
tip: underpants 常用复数；一条说 a pair of underpants。
scene: A folded pair of underpants on a shop shelf.

senses.en: below the surface of the water

ex.en: The diver took photos of underwater plants.
ex.zh: 潜水员拍了水下植物的照片。

ex.en: The fish swim underwater near the rocks.
ex.zh: 鱼在岩石附近的水下游动。

tip: underwater 是“水下的/在水下”。
scene: A diver taking photos of colourful fish underwater.

senses.en: the state of having no job

ex.en: Unemployment in the town has risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年这个镇的失业率上升了。

ex.en: The government is trying to reduce unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府正努力降低失业率。

tip: unemployment 是“失业/失业率”；unemployed 是“失业的”。
scene: A job centre with people reading vacancy boards.

senses.en: not important

ex.en: The colour of the box is unimportant.
ex.zh: 盒子的颜色不重要。

ex.en: Don't worry about unimportant details.
ex.zh: 别为无关紧要的细节担心。

tip: unimportant 是 important 的反义词“不重要的”。
scene: A person ignoring small unimportant papers on a desk.

senses.en: not interesting

ex.en: The lecture was long and uninteresting.
ex.zh: 讲座又长又无聊。

ex.en: He found the book uninteresting and put it down.
ex.zh: 他觉得这本书无趣就放下了。

tip: uninteresting 等于 boring“无趣的”。
scene: A student yawning during a long boring lecture.

senses.en: not certain about something

ex.en: I am unsure about the answer to this question.
ex.zh: 我不确定这道题的答案。

ex.en: She felt unsure about taking the job.
ex.zh: 她不确定是否接受这份工作。

tip: be unsure about/of 是“对…没把握”。
scene: A student hesitating with a hand half-raised in class.

senses.en: as many as; until; depending on

ex.en: The bus can carry up to fifty passengers.
ex.zh: 这辆公交车最多可载五十名乘客。

ex.en: It's up to you to decide.
ex.zh: 由你决定。

tip: up to 表示“多达/直到”；be up to sb 是“由某人决定”。
scene: A full bus with a sign showing passenger capacity.

senses.en: modern and current

ex.en: The app gives you up to date news.
ex.zh: 这个应用提供最新新闻。

ex.en: Keep your software up to date for safety.
ex.zh: 为安全起见保持软件更新。

tip: up to date 是“最新的”；反义 out of date。
scene: A smartphone showing the latest news feed.

senses.en: something happened regularly in the past but not now

ex.en: I used to play the piano when I was young.
ex.zh: 我年轻时曾经常弹钢琴。

ex.en: She used to live in this street.
ex.zh: 她以前住在这条街上。

tip: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯；be used to doing 是“习惯做”。
scene: An old piano in a corner, remembering the past.

senses.en: a short video

ex.en: She shared a funny video clip with her friends.
ex.zh: 她给朋友分享了一个搞笑短视频。

ex.en: The video clip of the concert went popular online.
ex.zh: 音乐会的视频片段在网上火了。

tip: video clip 是短视频/片段。
scene: A phone screen playing a short video clip with a play button.

senses.en: a room where people wait, e.g. at a doctor's

ex.en: We sat in the waiting room at the clinic.
ex.zh: 我们坐在诊所的候诊室里。

ex.en: The waiting room has magazines and chairs.
ex.zh: 候诊室有杂志和椅子。

tip: waiting room 是医院/车站等的等候室。
scene: A clinic waiting room with chairs, magazines and patients.

senses.en: to become old from use, or to make someone tired

ex.en: The soles of my shoes are worn out.
ex.zh: 我的鞋底磨破了。

ex.en: The long journey wore us out.
ex.zh: 漫长的旅途让我们精疲力竭。

tip: wear out 表示“磨损”或“使人疲惫”；worn out 是形容词。
scene: A worn-out pair of shoes with holes in the soles.

senses.en: a report about tomorrow's weather

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
ex.zh: 天气预报说明天晴朗。

ex.en: We watched the weather forecast before the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行前我们看了天气预报。

tip: weather forecast 是天气预报；forecast 也作动词“预报”。
scene: A TV weather presenter pointing at a sunny forecast map.

senses.en: a small camera used with a computer

ex.en: She turns off her webcam during online classes.
ex.zh: 上网课时她会关闭摄像头。

ex.en: The webcam has a built-in microphone.
ex.zh: 这个摄像头内置麦克风。

tip: webcam 是电脑摄像头，用于视频通话。
scene: A small webcam sitting on top of a laptop screen.

senses.en: if; used to express a choice

ex.en: I don't know whether she will come.
ex.zh: 我不知道她是否会来。

ex.en: Ask whether the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 问问商店周日是否开门。

tip: whether 与 if 都可表“是否”；whether 后可直接接 or not。
scene: A person on the phone asking whether a shop is open.

senses.en: used to talk about the future

ex.en: I will call you tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天会给你打电话。

ex.en: Will you come to my party on Saturday?
ex.zh: 你周六会来参加我的聚会吗？

tip: will + 动词原形表示将来；口语缩写 'll。
scene: A person talking on the phone, promising to call tomorrow.

senses.en: doing a job, or functioning

ex.en: The working hours here are nine to five.
ex.zh: 这里的工作时间是九点到五点。

ex.en: Is the machine still working?
ex.zh: 机器还在运转吗？

tip: working 是“工作的/运转的”；working hours 工作时间。
scene: People working at desks in an open office.

senses.en: informal way of saying yes

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'Yeah, I'll be there.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“嗯，我会去的。”

ex.en: Yeah, I really like this song.
ex.zh: 是啊，我真的很喜欢这首歌。

tip: yeah 是 yes 的口语形式，非正式场合用。
scene: A person nodding and saying yeah while talking with a friend.

senses.en: used in speech to check understanding

ex.en: You know, the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你知道的，车站附近那家新咖啡馆。

ex.en: It's a really nice place, you know.
ex.zh: 那是个很棒的地方，你懂的。

tip: you know 是口语填充语，用于引出对方已知的信息。
scene: Two friends chatting at a table, one gesturing with a hand.
